description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective From 30.12.2019 to 05.01.2020
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), which is a legal/regulatory framework. The content involves regulatory compliance requirements for customs payments and formally rescinds a previous notification, making it primarily concerned with legal and regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
